conduct_curriculum_autonomy_008.evidence: Any variation from the designated curriculum must be discussed with and approved by the appropriate curriculum program director, director, executive director of curriculum and instruction, and the assistant superintendent of curriculum and instruction.

conduct_lesson_plans_009.evidence: Lesson plans are to be completed in the curriculum management system and submitted according to the campus plan weekly. Lesson plans will be approved by the curriculum assistant and principal. Each building principal or assistant principal will create a system to make lesson plans available for substitutes in the event of unexpected teacher illness.
